Quick investigation (max 5 min) of the Obsidian memory integration in this harness. Report concisely (max 500 words):

1. `/mnt/dados/harness/memory/` — list files, read the main module (e.g. cerebral_memory.py or engine) — report its public API (ingest_source, create_summary, upsert_entity, upsert_concept signatures) and whether it can be run as `python3 -m cerebral_memory_engine`.
2. `/mnt/dados/harness/mcp/obsidian_server.py` — read it. Report: what MCP tools it exposes (names + params), and its safety features (traversal-safe?).
3. `/mnt/dados/cerebro com IA/` — top-level structure only (1 level deep), plus confirm existence of wiki/index.md, wiki/log.md, aprendizados/, decisoes/.
4. In `/mnt/dados/opencode/config/opencode.json` — is there an `mcp` entry for obsidian? What other mcp servers are configured (names only)?
5. Does any hook load memory at session start? Check `/mnt/dados/opencode/config/hooks/` — list hook files and note any that touch memory/obsidian/context.
6. Check `~/.config/opencode/agent/` for a memory-keeper agent file — report its prompt essence (10 lines max).

Output: compact structured report with section 1-6.
